solver_settings.caching_policy: No cached solver outputs; fresh RHS and T0 vector copies per execution
solver_settings.residual_definition: True unpreconditioned relative Euclidean residual ||F - K·T||_2 / ||F||_2

directly_measured: iterations (exact loop counter to convergence or limit)
nnz_factors (exact nonzeros in L and U from SuperLU)
derived_or_analytical: median_runtime_ms, mean_runtime_ms, std_runtime_ms (sample statistics over N repetitions)
memory_mb = base_system_memory_mb + additional_solver_memory_mb (analytical sparse data-structure byte accounting)
asymptotic_rate_estimate (geometric mean of trailing 50 residual ratios)

direct_lu.memory_measurement_method: Consistent Analytical Sparse Data-Structure Allocation (Base CSR System + Additional Solver Workspace, MB)
direct_lu.description: Sparse direct factorization; cost dominated by 3D fill-in of L and U.

conjugate_gradient.memory_measurement_method: Consistent Analytical Sparse Data-Structure Allocation (Base CSR System + Additional Solver Workspace, MB)
conjugate_gradient.description: Krylov method; optimal in K-norm over the Krylov subspace, O(N) additional memory.

sor.memory_measurement_method: Consistent Analytical Sparse Data-Structure Allocation (Base CSR System + Additional Solver Workspace, MB)
sor.description: Stationary relaxation; convergence factor ρ(G_ω) governs iterations.

results.winner_explanation:
Direct LU: factor fill-in ratio nnz(L+U)/nnz(K) = 6.1, factor memory 3.47 MB vs CG working memory 0.60 MB (5.8x). Fill-in, not arithmetic on K, drives LU cost and grows super-linearly with DOF in 3D.
CG converged in 88 iterations (41.8 ms) to relative residual 9.50e-07; max deviation from LU 8.79e-06 K. K is symmetric positive definite, so CG minimises the K-norm error over the Krylov subspace and resolves the isolated small eigenvalue (near-uniform temperature mode) in few iterations.
SOR (ω=1.90) converged in 393 iterations (2939.2 ms) — 4.5x CG's iteration count. Each SOR sweep is a sequential triangular solve, so it is also slower per iteration.
Recommendation for this system (2080 DOF): Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (Jacobi) (fastest converged); lowest memory among converged: Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (Jacobi). Only solvers that reached the tolerance are eligible.
